de: Battle of Poitiers: An English army under the command of Edward the Black Prince defeats a French army and captures King John II.

de: Siege of Damascus: The Rashidun Arabs under Khalid ibn al-Walid capture Damascus from the Byzantine Empire.

dz: 内尔瓦被怀疑是多米蒂安之死同谋,被元老院宣布为皇帝. 参议院随后废除了多米蒂安通过的法律并下令将他的雕像摧毁.
de: Nerva, suspected of complicity of the death of Domitian, is declared emperor by Senate. The Senate then annuls laws passed by Domitian and orders his statues to be destroyed.
